device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU; CUDA with PyTorch 2.6.0+cu124
archive_comparison: All 2271 state, target, action_type, action_bound, action_path, group, and split rows are identical to the previous archive. Only raw-tree SHA-256 identities were added.
protocol: Fixed 80 epochs, 30 within-type permutations, three seeds, original validation weighted-MSE checkpoint selection, optional paired matching weight 0.1. The comparison keeps all model inputs and evaluation rows fixed and changes only pair identity and paired-training membership.

decision: Do not promote. Exact-tree correction removes most apparent branches, and paired-loss training increases overall held-out weighted MSE in all six matched comparisons without consistent branch gains.
limitations: Identical raw accessibility trees can still have different hidden browser state or history.
